mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doctor (name, code, title, department_id, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{title}, #{departmentId}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE doctor SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, title = #{title}, department_id = #{departmentId}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, title, department_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM doctor
